$comment: Maps INHERIT person roles to Practice Management Software role taxonomies. Used by WillScan.ai and other export tools to create contacts with correct roles in target PMS systems.
title: PMS Role Mappings
description: Mapping of INHERIT person roles to role names in major legal Practice Management Software systems.

clio.name: Clio (Manage & Grow)
clio.notes: Clio uses preconfigured Wills & Estates custom field sets with up to 4 executor slots and 10 beneficiary slots. Contacts are created first, then linked to matters via relationships.

actionstep.name: Actionstep
actionstep.notes: Actionstep uses typed Participants linked to Actions (matters). Each participant type can have its own custom data fields. Best data model fit for INHERIT's people-with-roles concept. $500 API setup fee.

leap.name: LEAP Legal Software
leap.notes: LEAP uses Cards (contacts) linked to Matters via participant roles. Pre-built matter types for wills and probate. API access requires developer registration. Zapier integration available.

mycase.name: MyCase
mycase.notes: MyCase uses Contacts and Companies linked to Cases. Estate-specific data captured via DecisionVault integration or custom fields. Custom fields must be pre-created before import.

practicepanther.name: PracticePanther
practicepanther.notes: PracticePanther uses Accounts (contacts) linked to Matters. No pre-built estate planning field sets — custom fields and custom contact types must be created. Zapier is the primary integration route for most firms.
